goal: I want to be alerted when checkout breaks on https://shop.example.com
summary: Two things have to exist: a rule that defines "checkout breaks on https://shop.example.com" as a failure, and an alert that watches it. We'll build the rule first, then attach the alert, then point it at https://shop.example.com.

steps.say: Start with the rule — that is the part that actually detects the failure. Search is the quickest way to the Rule Library.

targetFallback.description: the global search box in the top nav

steps.say: Create a new rule. This is where you say what "checkout breaks on https://shop.example.com" means in ObservePoint terms.

targetFallback.description: the button to create a new rule

steps.say: Naming it "Copilot: failure check" — this is the name you'll see in the alert email, so make it obvious.
Add the condition itself: checkout breaks on https://shop.example.com. Pick the tag you care about and set it to alert when it is missing.

targetFallback.description: the button to add a rule condition

steps.say: Rule saved. Now the alert — that is what decides who hears about it.
Create the alert and point it at the rule you just made, watching https://shop.example.com. Notifications go to your account email.

targetFallback.description: the button to create a new alert
